Later track calls receive the current decoded registered image pair; crops use prior predictions and history/template updates use predicted state and confidence. No-grad, eval mode, disabled parameter gradients, end-of-run exact state tensor equality and absent gradients guard zero training. Tracker templates/history intentionally evolve. TF32 is disabled. No latency, FPS, parameter-state witness or inference was measured here.
